integrity: A self-contained proof and independent finite enumerations are included. Experimental checks through order eight corroborate rather than replace the unrestricted proof. This is not a formal proof assistant certificate or an independent review.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for finite labeled Zimin words and circular factors of total length at most one circumference. The statement is not for arbitrary Abelian-squarefree palindromes. Historical priority over unindexed results has not been independently established.
title: Circular Abelian-power rigidity and exact rotation profiles of Zimin words
